acceptanceItems.text: `grep -c 'unrelated context' workflows/deliver-pipeline.js agents/theo.md` prints `workflows/deliver-pipeline.js:2` and `agents/theo.md:1` (the constant and `THEO_PERSONA`).

`node scripts/run-flow-suite.cjs > $TMPDIR/out.txt 2>&1; grep -c 'PASS — T9010 ' $TMPDIR/out.txt` prints `1` (T9010 is free on main), and `tail -n 1 $TMPDIR/out.txt` prints `[flow-suite] status=test-ok passed=340 failed=0` (339 measured on main plus 1).

`OFFLINE_STRICT=1 node scripts/run-offline.cjs --all fixtures > $TMPDIR/out.txt 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -n 1 $TMPDIR/out.txt` prints `rc=0` then `[offline] status=ok passed=65 failed=0` (64 measured on main plus the one R2 fixture of ac:8), and `git diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD -- fixtures` prints exactly `A<TAB>fixtures/incidents/10-request-pin.json` (no existing fixture changes: every replay still answers by label).

`node scripts/guards.cjs > $TMPDIR/out.txt 2>&1; echo rc=$?` prints `rc=0`, and `bash tests/templates/test-canonical-guards.sh > $TMPDIR/out.txt 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -n 1 $TMPDIR/out.txt` prints `rc=0` then a line ending `failed=0` (R1 counters unchanged).
`node scripts/audit.cjs --check` prints `PASS: audit:` and exits 0, and `git diff -- scripts/audit-baseline.json` prints nothing.

`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` lists only `workflows/deliver-pipeline.js` (the constant, the `callAgent` prefix, `THEO_PERSONA`), `agents/theo.md` (the rule), `templates/test-deliver-pipeline.js` (flow-suite case T9010) and `fixtures/incidents/10-request-pin.json` (R2 incident fixture); no template holds a byte-identical copy of the touched engine block, and `bash tests/templates/test-probe-run.sh` last line stays `[probe-run] status=ok passed=198 failed=0`.

`node scripts/run-offline.cjs fixtures/incidents/10-request-pin.json; echo rc=$?` prints `[offline] status=ok passed=1 failed=0` then `rc=0` (R2 replay: green on the branch, red on main for the reason shown in the proof log).
